content: Un'kyɛɛl uboo Ikööŋ
Abun, atɔŋ, bɛ làkyer alɔŋàkà akà bi naa nkääl abɛ ikal aben mupà Nzam un'sak, bɛ sye làfàkyer abun. Apanà, bi kàmàlalɔɔm anà kàmàlalɛɛl kikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu, fàlakyerà yàŋàsöönà.
Ntɔn, bɛ làkyàyöb nswɛɛŋ kàlapɛ bi, nswɛŋ yàfü akà Mwol Yɛsu.
Ukwen a Nzam bà naa bɛ làbulà aŋin'kyɛɛl: wɛy bɛ làtön induumà.
Wɛy umwɛy umwɛy uboo a bɛ uyöb muwal un'kaar unsà un'kyɛɛl anà ibyääl,
ntɔn mukɔɔn akal ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b a làmfɛɛl asànaa bàfàkyer baar mpa abà Ayudà mpa bàyöb Nzam.
Unsà ndaa ayi, wɛy mbuur ukɔɔn akyer un'tɔŋ ande ube anà akɔɔn akun'kur, ntɔn Mwol afàpà ntaaŋàmbar unsà indiir abi byanswà, asànaa kàtɛn bi anà kàlaweey bi itaan.
Ntɔn Nzam kibeel anki ntɔn bi ikäl uboo a ŋingyäy, wɛɛ kibeel mukal uboo a un'kyɛɛl.
Kyakin, mbuur apiy nswɛɛŋ ayi, kà mbuur anki nde kan'piy, wɛɛ Nzam, Nde awà afàlapà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ande.
Ntɔn ukwen a atɔŋ anà atɔŋ, mfun mukàlasöön yatɛy, ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo Nzam kàkyàlalɔŋ naa bɛ làkal anà ukwen bɛ a bɛ.
Anà bɛ làfàkyer abun akà atɔŋ banswà u bul a Masɛdwan lanswà. Atɔŋ, bi kàmàlalɛɛl, fàlakyerà yàŋàsöönà!
Làkäl anà ngyal mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a duu: wɛy mbuur mbuur ukyer indiir ande ŋakwo anà udi mbɛŋ a isal a an'kɔɔ ande ŋakwo, asànaa kàlaswɛŋ bi.
Abun, nkääl abɛ iyàkal yibyääl kusà a baar mpa abà aklistɔ, waa bɛ mpa làyàkal anà mfun a mbuur.
Ngyeel a Mwol
Atɔŋ, bi ikwen naa bɛ làyöb ndandaa ntɔn akü, ntɔn bɛ làkɔɔn akal u ngyɛb asànaa baar bumwɛy bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkyän.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa bi ibye anà làkwikilà naa Yɛsu kàkyàkwà anà kàkyàwiyà, bi kan'sà làkwikilà sye naa Nzam, u mbwo a Yɛsu, asàsyen baar bàkü amu Yɛsu.
Le, undiir itɛɛnà bi a bɛ kan'fà u Ndaa a Mwol: baar bàsàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ uboo a bi umpal usàyà Mwol, bàsàfwel anki baar bàkü.
Ntɔn nde ŋakwo, Mwol, u ndaa a ngwal anà u ndaa a mfum a akyeey, anà say a mfuŋ a Nzam, Mwol ŋakwo asyetyà fà du, baar bàkü amu Klistɔ bàsàwiyà bàtàtwɛb,
ungö, bi baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abà isàsaal, Nzam asisɛɛn anà ba uboo a itööm, ntɔn mukàbwey anà Mwol u du. Abun bi isàkal ipepey anà Mwol.
Làlɛɛl bɛ a bɛ u mbwo a ndaa ayi.
